history.basis: 6-K exhibit text matched results language (7 filings opened). Heuristic, not an item code: a 6-K carrying results language is very likely an earnings release but this is weaker than the 8-K item 2.02 path

event_plausibility.reason: Off 'suspect' to 'unknown'. The 6-K matcher read the 2026-11-12 special-dividend and dividend-policy announcement as a print; the last real print was Q2 on 2026-08-28, and the company's own release of 2026-11-23 sets Q3 results for 2026-11-30 before the US open, call 07:00 ET. 'unknown', not fits_cadence, because the reaction history mixes non-earnings 6-Ks.

amended_from.reason: an event 18 days after the last print does not fit a 91-day cadence; the calendar row may be stale

event_plausibility.amended_by: stage E-P v3b orchestrator from the edge sweep's company source; applied after the searchers, before scoring (hand-applied, the shared AMENDMENTS table left to stage E-P)

deadband_basis: half the median of 7 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
baseline_quality.history_discount_note: reaction history is present but not counted toward the tier: the event date does not fit this company's own filing cadence, so the history may describe a reporting regime it no longer follows
